_cases: Parses per process. The three cases whose processes split into a fast and a slow mode before tree objects were constructor-built (#224, #230).
_pads: Bytes of never-called code appended to dist/index.js. 970 bytes was enough to move Jess's .jess parser from 0 of 16 to 8 of 16 slow processes on Node 24.
_maxMarkCompacts: Per process. The fast mode runs 1-2 mark-compacts on these counts; a pretenured process ran 15-61.
